# Evolute Institute

> Evolute Institute offers professionally guided, medically supervised psilocybin retreat programs in the Netherlands and darkness retreats in Germany, designed for professionals and leaders seeking clarity, psychological integration, and lasting personal change. The organization maintains a 1:2 facilitator-to-participant ratio with a Medical Doctor physically present on-site during every ceremony.

## Services

- [EvoSHIFT Psilocybin Retreat](https://evolute-institute.com/psilocybin-retreat-netherlands-evoshift/): A 12-week medically supervised psilocybin retreat program at Centrum Athanor, Netherlands. Groups of 6–10 participants maximum. Includes structured preparation, a four-day on-site ceremony, and integration support. 1:2 facilitator ratio. Medical Doctor physically on-site during ceremony.
- [EvoDARK Darkness Retreat](https://evolute-institute.com/evodark-darkness-retreat/): Extended sensory darkness retreat in Germany's Black Forest. Designed as a contemplative practice for deep introspection without psychoactive substances.
- [Evolute Private Retreat](https://evolute-institute.com/evolute-private-legal-psychedelic-retreat/): Private version of EvoSHIFT for individuals or very small groups. Custom design.
- [Evolute 1:1 Coaching](https://evolute-institute.com/evolute-psychedelic-integration-coaching/): Standalone psychedelic integration coaching for people processing a previous experience or preparing for one.

## Key Information

- [About Evolute / Our Approach](https://evolute-institute.com/our-approach/): Evolute's philosophical and clinical approach to psilocybin facilitation, including the interdisciplinary team model and theoretical frameworks (ACT, IFS, Somatic Experiencing, adult development theory).
- [Team](https://evolute-institute.com/team/): Co-founders Dr. Dmitrij Achelrod (PhD, Health Economics, Hamburg & Oxford) and Christopher Kabakis (M.Sc., Affiliate Professor at ESCP Europe Business School).
- [FAQ](https://evolute-institute.com/faq/): Frequently asked questions including legal status, safety protocols, screening process, and program structure.
- [Apply](https://evolute-institute.com/apply/): Application entry point for all retreat programs.
- [Book a Call](https://cal.com/evolute/30-min-meeting): 30-minute introductory call to assess fit and eligibility.
- [Upcoming Retreats](https://evolute-institute.com/upcoming-retreats/): Current retreat dates and availability.

## Psilocybin Content

- [What is Psilocybin?](https://evolute-institute.com/psilocybin/what-is-psilocybin-netherlands/): Evidence-based overview of psilocybin, its mechanisms, legal status in the Netherlands, and clinical research context.
- [Psilocybin Ceremony](https://evolute-institute.com/psilocybin/psilocybin-ceremony-netherlands/): What happens during a facilitated psilocybin ceremony, including preparation and safety protocols.
- [Psilocybin Retreats and Personal Development](https://evolute-institute.com/psilocybin/psilocybin-retreat-personal-development-netherlands/): How structured psilocybin retreat programs support personal and professional development.
- [Set, Setting & Integration](https://evolute-institute.com/psilocybin/set-setting-psilocybin-retreat/): The three pillars of safe psychedelic work: mindset, environment, and post-experience integration.
- [What is a Psychedelic Therapy Retreat?](https://evolute-institute.com/psilocybin/what-is-a-psychedelic-therapy-retreat/): Definition and clinical context of professionally structured psychedelic retreat programs.
- [Psilocybin Research](https://evolute-institute.com/psilocybin-research/): Academic and clinical research on psilocybin-assisted retreats.

## Darkness Retreat Content

- [What is a Darkness Retreat?](https://evolute-institute.com/darkness-retreats/what-is-a-darkness-retreat/): Definition and description of extended darkness as a contemplative practice.
- [Benefits of Darkness Retreats](https://evolute-institute.com/darkness-retreats/benefits-of-darkness-retreats/): Evidence-informed overview of the psychological and physiological effects of extended darkness.

## Key Facts

- Legal status: Psilocybin truffles are fully legal in the Netherlands. Darkness retreats operate in Germany.
- Facilitator ratio: 1:2 (one facilitator per two participants)
- Medical supervision: Medical Doctor physically on-site during every EvoSHIFT ceremony — not on call, in the room
- Screening: Medical and psychiatric screening conducted by a psychiatrist before acceptance
- Group size: 6–10 participants maximum (EvoSHIFT)
- Program depth: 12 weeks (preparation + ceremony + integration)
- Individual sessions: 4 individual 1:1 coaching sessions per participant
- Academic collaborations: UCSF, Carhart-Harris Lab (Imperial College London), Universiteit Leiden, University of Amsterdam, University of St. Gallen, ESCP Business School, Leuphana University, Hochschule für angewandtes Management
- Media coverage: Der Spiegel, NZZ, Manager Magazin, Condé Nast Traveller, ZDF, Der Tagesspiegel
- Primary market: English-speaking and German-speaking professionals across Europe and internationally
- Founded: 2022
- Website: https://evolute-institute.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/evolute-institute/
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@evoluteinstitute
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/evolute_institute
